name: SPA + API: React, FastAPI and Postgres
summary: A React single-page app talking to a typed Python API over JSON, with Postgres behind it. The common default for a product with a signed-in web UI and a Python-leaning team.

fitsWhen.says: a web app people sign in to
the team writes Python or TypeScript

avoidWhen.says: pages must rank in search engines (a SPA renders in the browser)

frontend.why: Largest ecosystem and hiring pool; with Vite the dev loop is fast and the build is a static bundle any CDN can serve.

backend.why: Typed request/response models give validation and an OpenAPI document for free, and the front end can generate its client from it.

database.why: Relational integrity, JSONB for the odd flexible field, and full-text search before a search engine is needed.

cache.why: Sessions, rate limits and the job queue's broker in one small service.

queue.why: Emails, exports and imports leave the request path and are retried.

auth.why: Cookie sessions issued by the API; an external identity provider only when enterprise SSO is asked for.

infra.why: One compose file runs the whole stack locally and on a single server; move to Kubernetes only when there are many services.

ci-cd.why: Lint, typecheck, tests and image builds on every pull request.

observability.why: Traces from the browser call to the SQL query; exported to whatever backend is chosen later.

testing.why: pytest for the API against a real Postgres; Vitest and Playwright for the UI.

hosting.why: Managed web service, worker and Postgres from git with no cluster to run.

services.name: web
responsibilities: Calls the API with the session cookie

services.name: api
responsibilities: Owns the domain rules and validation
Reads and writes Postgres through SQLAlchemy

dataStores.name: db
dataStores.purpose: The system of record; schema changed only through Alembic migrations

dataStores.name: cache
dataStores.purpose: Sessions, rate limits and the job broker

environments.name: dev
environments.hosting: docker compose up: web, api, worker, Postgres, Redis

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: A copy of production for checking a release
environments.hosting: A Render preview of the main branch with its own database

environments.name: prod
environments.hosting: Render web service + worker + managed Postgres with daily backups

stages.name: test
stages.does: pytest against a Postgres service container, vitest

stages.name: build
stages.does: Docker images tagged with the commit

stages.name: deploy
stages.does: main deploys to staging; a tag deploys to prod

notes: Migrations run as a release step, never at app start
Structured JSON logs with a request id
A /health endpoint that checks the database

security.auth: HttpOnly session cookies set by the API; CSRF header on writes
security.secrets: Environment variables from the host's secret store; .env only for local dev and never committed
notes: Validate every input at the API boundary and return typed errors, never stack traces.
Parameterised queries only (the ORM), so no SQL is built from strings.
Set secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookies or short-lived tokens; rate-limit sign-in.
Check authorisation on every endpoint on the server, not only in the UI (OWASP A01 Broken Access Control).

Tests hit a real Postgres, not mocks

adrs.title: Single-page app over server-rendered pages
adrs.decision: The UI is a React SPA served as static files.
adrs.why: The product is used signed in, so search indexing does not matter and a rich client pays off.

adrs.title: One API service, not microservices
adrs.decision: All domain logic lives in one FastAPI service.
adrs.why: One team, one deploy, transactions across the whole domain; split later along real seams.

repos.label: app
repos.layout: web/ and api/ in one repository, run together by docker compose

files.template: What the system is, how to start it with docker compose, and where each part lives.
Services web (Vite dev server), api (uvicorn --reload), worker (celery), db (postgres:16) and cache (redis:7), with a named volume for Postgres.
Python 3.12 project with fastapi, uvicorn, sqlalchemy[asyncio], asyncpg, alembic, celery, redis; dev: pytest, ruff, mypy.
FastAPI app with a /health route that checks the database, CORS for the web origin, and the routers included.
Async SQLAlchemy engine and session dependency reading DATABASE_URL.
pytest that calls /health through httpx and expects 200.
Vite + React + TypeScript app with scripts dev, build, test (vitest), lint.
A first screen that calls the API's /health and shows the answer.
GitHub Actions: lint, typecheck and tests for api/ and web/ on every pull request.
